requested_prompt:
[Deliverable]
Create one polished, flat portrait 2:3 proposal-and-quotation document for the fictional MORNING POST café brand. This is a printable page design, not a photograph, desk scene, mockup or perspective-distorted sheet. Treat the quoted Korean and English copy as authoritative artwork text: do not translate, paraphrase or shorten it.
[Layout]
Ivory paper, forest-green headings, restrained coral rules, modern editorial sans-serif typography with proper Hangul glyphs. Keep 6% safe margins. Top 14%: bilingual project name, document title, document number and issue date. Next 25%: project overview in two stacked paragraphs, Korean then English. Middle 30%: a four-column quotation table, with row labels at left and amounts right-aligned. Lower 24%: schedule at left and approval checklist at right. Bottom: team name and page number. Use real baseline alignment, clear hierarchy and comfortable leading. Small text must remain readable at native resolution.
[Exact headings and metadata]
모닝포스트 브랜드 론칭
MORNING POST BRAND LAUNCH
제작 제안 및 견적서
CREATIVE PROPOSAL & QUOTATION
문서번호 MP-2026-014
발행일 2026.10.09
프로젝트 개요 / Project Overview
[Exact Korean paragraph]
동네 카페의 첫인상을 메뉴판과 패키지, 캐릭터 콘텐츠로 연결합니다. 한글과 영어를 함께 사용하되, 메뉴 이름과 가격을 가장 먼저 읽을 수 있도록 정보의 위계를 정리합니다. 모든 이미지와 문구는 실제 매장 안내와 온라인 홍보에 맞춰 제작합니다.
[Exact English paragraph]
We connect the first impression of a neighborhood café through menus, packaging and character-led content. Korean and English appear together, with clear names, prices and reading order. Every visual is planned for both in-store communication and digital promotion.
[Table; vertical bars define columns and are not literal artwork characters]

이름·가격·알레르기 문구 확인
Check names, prices and allergen copy.
